feed.title: Standby Atlas: data-centre filings naming Kohler (Rehlko)

entry.title: Esfandyar Ventures One SARL data centre in Frankfurt am Main, Germany: Emissions permit granted (BImSchG)
entry.summary: Emissions permit granted (BImSchG) on 10 Sep 2025. 60 backup generators. 392 MW of thermal input. Engine makes named: MTU, Caterpillar, Kohler (Rehlko). Source: Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt.

entry.title: Interxion France data centre in La Courneuve, France: Other filing
entry.summary: Other filing on 23 May 2025. 72 backup generators. 355.8 MW of thermal input. Engine makes named: Kohler (Rehlko). Source: Géorisques (French installations register).

entry.title: Horizon Data Center Frankfurt LLC data centre in Frankfurt am Main, Germany: Emissions permit granted (BImSchG)
entry.summary: Emissions permit granted (BImSchG) on 8 Aug 2024. 24 backup generators. 170 MW of thermal input. Engine makes named: MTU, Caterpillar, Kohler (Rehlko). Source: Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt.
